messages.content: You route spatial service tasks. An agent appends work to its FIFO queue. It cannot start travelling until both now and its committed_finish have passed. Travel is Euclidean distance from queue_end_position to task location divided by speed. Execution duration is workload divided by its proficiency for required_skill (floor 0.05). Estimate the duration from now until this task completes, including waiting, travel and execution. Use only the supplied state. Show brief step-by-step working: for each agent compute the waiting time, travel time and execution time and their sum, which is its estimated completion duration, one short line per agent; then choose the agent with the smallest duration, breaking ties by smallest id. End your response with the answer as a JSON object on its own final line: {"agent_id": integer}.
